item.title: I Started Building a Thinking Clone
item.description:
I’m embarrassingly lazy, so I thought,

“Wouldn’t it be nice if I had an AI that could post things for me?”

That was all it started as—just a light, lazy idea.

But once I actually began, the texture turned out to be way deeper and more interesting than I expected.

I’d always wanted to do something like this.

Until now, though, my approach had been more like,
“Let’s just have an AI do things in a nice way for me.”

item.title: Tangled feeling
item.description:
Today, something happened that wasn’t exactly bad,
but left me with a faint, uncomfortable feeling.

It was nothing serious—
just the kind of thing that lingers in your head
and turns into a soft, cloudy unease.

When that happens, trying to think it through only makes things worse.

They were rude.
It’s my fault.

The brain is quick to slap labels on it like that.

So in moments like this,
the best thing to do is not to think at all—
just to feel the tangled threads.

item.title: First post
item.description:
My first post. …excluding the “test post.”

Just to start. No plan, nor style. I just needed to write something for the first step, Otherwise I won’t start writing anything.

My goal here is to get out of the perfectionism and just put my foggy thoughts out here. This is how the world works, I think.
